SELECT time_bucket, SUM(upper(segment) - lower(segment)) / COUNT(DISTINCT video_play_session.user_id) AS value
FROM generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, #{filter.end}::timestamp with time zone - #{filter.start}::timestamp with time zone) AS time_bucket
FROM generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval) AS time_bucket
LEFT JOIN video_play_segment ON create_time >= time_bucket AND create_time < time_bucket + concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval LEFT JOIN video_play_session ON video_play_session.id = video_play_segment.session_id AND master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket;

SELECT time_bucket, AVG(ratio) AS value FROM ( SELECT time_bucket, CASE WHEN COUNT(engagement_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY time_bucket) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE COUNT(engagement_rate) FILTER (WHERE engagement_rate < #{dropOffThreshold} AND engagement_rate != 0.0) OVER (PARTITION BY time_bucket) / COUNT(engagement_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY time_bucket)::double precision END AS ratio FROM ( SELECT time_bucket, (SUM(upper(segment) - lower(segment)) / video_long::double precision) / COUNT(DISTINCT video_play_session.id) AS engagement_rate
FROM ( SELECT #{filter.start}::timestamp with time zone AS time_bucket UNION SELECT #{filter.end}::timestamp with time zone ) AS time_bucket
FROM generate_series(#{filter.start}, #{filter.end}, concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval) AS time_bucket
LEFT JOIN video_play_segment ON
video_play_segment.update_time >= time_bucket AND video_play_segment.update_time < time_bucket + concat(#{filter.step}, ' second')::interval
video_play_segment.update_time <= time_bucket
LEFT JOIN video_play_session ON video_play_session.id = video_play_segment.session_id AND master_id = #{masterId} LEFT JOIN gc_video ON video_play_session.video_id = gc_video.id LEFT JOIN sys_file ON gc_video.file_id = sys_file.id GROUP BY time_bucket, video_long, session_id) AS engagement ) AS drop_off GROUP BY time_bucket ORDER BY time_bucket;
